description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1. (2:44) I've long questioned why consistent methodology appears to be broken when interpreting the 7 last plagues. We consistently use symbols when symbolic language and content are used except in these plagues. It appears we literalize all of the plagues except the river Euphrates. This bends my mind a bit and violates consistency. So wouldn't it be best to use symbolic interpretation on all of the plagues (not just one)?
.
2. (14:59) Greetings Pastor Bohr. I would like to find out from you how to perform Christian meditation.
.
3. (24:06) I have a question that has been bothering me a bit over the past few weeks. I have always understood that The Law of God existed before man's creation, that it is eternal in nature. "The moral law was never a type or shadow. It existed before man's creation, and will endure as long as God's throne remains...It is unchangeable, unalterable, infinite, and eternal." (RH April 22, 1902) But, the fourth commandment, seems to me to be exclusively connected to the creation of this world. (See Exodus 20:11) It seems, on the surface, that the Sabbath wasn't eternal, but was "made for man" (Mark 2:27). If that is so, how can the law be eternal? Or was the Sabbath added to the law during the creation week? But, if that is the case how can the law be eternal? Please help.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
